summary: # Marvelous Designer 2024: Ruffle Skirt Tutorial In this tutorial, we are going to make a skirt with ruffle detailing. We'll create a three-tiered skirt section, learn how to scale a skirt, and create ruffle patterns. We'll also learn how to improve fabric quality and how to apply a chiffon fabric. ## Getting Started First, download and open the ruffle skirt base file from the Marvelous Designer channel in Connect, which can be found in the description box of this video. The basic t-shirt, pants, and skirt waist patterns have been created. ## Creating the Skirt Base For this skirt, we are going to create a design with a lot of gathering, so we will create the skirt part using a semi-circle pattern. 1. **Select the Ellipse Tool**: In the 2D pattern window, select the Ellipse tool. 2. **Create a Full Circle Pattern**: While creating the pattern, press down on the Shift and Control keys to create a full circle pattern from the center point. 3. **Positioning**: If you start with the mouse cursor at the avatar's waist, you can estimate the length of the skirt based on the size of the circle's radius. 4. **Adjusting the Pattern**: Delete the leftmost point because we are going to make it into a half-circle. In the center, create a curved line for the waistline. The hemline should look like this: - Use the **ADD Point Split** tool to create a center point using the Smart guideline as a reference. - For the waistline length, set it to 3.7' and 6.5'. ## Creating the Waistline and Hemline 1. **Internal Ellipse Tool**: Select the Internal Ellipse tool and click and drag from the center point to create a waist curve. 2. **Create Internal Circle**: Again, press Control and Shift to create an internal circle around that center point. 3. **Sew the Waistline**: Use the Freesewing tool to sew the waistline. Begin with a lift on the waistline, then reverse the sewing to about 24-25 inches. ## Simulating the Skirt Pattern - Simulate the skirt pattern in the 3D window. Resize the pattern to get the desired length. - To create the ruffle pattern, rearrange the skirt pattern using the Reset 3D Arrangement menu. Ruffles are easier to attach to flat patterns. ## Preparing for Ruffles 1. **Deactivate and Hide Avatar**: Deactivate the avatar's arms and hide the avatar. 2. **Cut the Waistline**: Cut out the waistline and delete the remaining pattern. 3. **Create Ruffle Lines**: Select the waistline and hemlines and use the offset as internal lines to create additional lines along the curve. ### Ruffle Pattern Creation 1. **Use the Offset Menu**: Use the offset as internal line menu to create internal lines on both sides of the internal shape. - For distance, enter the desired width of the ruffle pattern. I'll enter 20mm. 2. **Reverse Direction**: Change the reverse direction setting to create a line on the opposite side. 3. **Clone the Pattern**: Use the layer clone option in the menu to clone the pattern on the face side of the original pattern. ## Finalizing the Ruffle Patterns 1. **Remove Linked Editing**: Use the remove linked editing menu to delete the instance links between the two pieces. 2. **Select and Cut Ruffle Patterns**: Select the lines that will become the ruffle patterns and right-click to choose cut. Delete the excess patterns, leaving only the items that will become the ruffles. 3. **Freeze the Skirt Pattern**: Freeze the skirt pattern itself while you create the ruffles. ### Simulating and Adjusting Ruffles 1. **Increase Ruffle Size**: Increase the size of the ruffle pattern and then simulate. If you're not happy with the simulation results, press Ctrl + Z and return to the pre-simulation state. 2. **Modify Width**: To modify the width of the ruffle pattern, select the outline you want to change and then choose the offset pattern outline menu. Enter the desired value to adjust the width. 3. **Set Particle Distance**: Set the skirt pattern to a particle distance of 10 and the ruffles to a particle distance of 5 for better simulation quality. ## Adding Elastic and Final Touches 1. **Use the Elastic Menu**: For gathering or shirring, apply elastic to the ruffle lines to create a more pulled-in or gathered-looking crease. 2. **Adjust Values**: Press Ctrl + Z to return to the original selection and enter a different number if needed. 3. **Assigning Fabric**: Add a new fabric and set it to Chiffon for the project. ## Conclusion This is how you can create a skirt with ruffles using Marvelous Designer 2024. Thank you for watching!
